/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"import pandas as pd; df=pd.read_excel('programme_monthly_spend.xlsx', header=None); rows=df.iloc[5:]; # rows from data
# extract programme name col1, total col10
data=[]
for i in range(len(rows)):
    code=rows.iloc[i,0]
    prog=rows.iloc[i,1]
    total=rows.iloc[i,10]
    if pd.isna(code): continue
    data.append((code,prog,total))
for d in data:
    print(d)
# find max
max_item=max(data, key=lambda x: (x[2] if pd.notna(x[2]) else -1))
print('max',max_item)
\""
